title: HTML report videos open and seek in the authenticated player
description: Opt-in live proof on an owned authenticated CC tab with the report open. Set FARMSLOT_PROOF_RUN_ID, FARMSLOT_CDP_ENDPOINT, FARMSLOT_HTML_REPORT_PROOF_OUT and FARMSLOT_PROOF_BROWSER_MODULE, pointing to an external playwright-core@1.56.1 installation. No product commands are sent; all media opens use real clicks.

proofTargets.claim: Every report video becomes a link, opens the authenticated player, reaches metadata readiness, plays and seeks without weakening the report sandbox.

videos.intent: Click every video link in the real retained report, play and seek each video, and verify no dead embedded player or related media error remains.
